construction.input: For four actual rows X_i, mu=mean(X), c=sum_i epsilon_i(X_i-mu)/2, using the same epsilon_i across all channels.
construction.response: For selected stripes, two original W1/GELU/Q2 responses at mu+c and mu-c, average post-Q2 then oneW2; other stripes use one response at mu. Subtract mean precomputed L and add own L per token.
construction.action: Fixed total3958 of7917 horizontal4 stripes get two-point rather than one-point response. A future policy may rank pre-W1 input contrast norms, but none is fit/tested now.
construction.why_old_obstruction_changes: The common-output contrast bound does not apply after ownL contrasts are preserved. Single-anchor sampling noise is not inherent to estimating a pooled mean. Shared signs retain joint variation that independent marginal moments discard. New evidence supports these narrow distinctions, not a successful native method.
construction.unresolved_obstructions: Ideal mean still poor at step1/3; joint cubature can be biased and noisy through discontinuousQ2; L storage/QDQ/layout can dominate speed; selector may have no same-cost fixed-control advantage; native BF16/matrix-shape differences untested.
construction.falsifiable_prediction: At the initially motivated step2 scope, a coupled pooled mean-response should reduce actual remainder error relative to a one-row anchor, and some before-W1 input statistic must predict incremental two-point value beyond best fixed placement. Failure of either keeps it an unsupported candidate.

controls_required_before_promotion: Frozen UB1 on identical native operands.
Two-point response at strongest training-selected fixed spatial placement with exactly the same count and same calibration/weights.
Dynamic placement using the identical two operator arms and total count.
Relevant ToMe/ToMA-style merge/unmerge comparison when making novelty or efficiency claims.

data_exposure: All24 original OP2 sources are development-exposed; R9 fit used odd12 only. No fresh quality evaluation occurred. New final quality must use independently audited frozen sources and full free student trajectories after method freezing.
cheapest_next_discriminator: Inspect a three-direction projection/reconstruction memory schedule and a prospective fixed synthetic cost comparison before any Wan collection. Only after backend feasibility is positive should complete-stripe native operands and actual conditional gain be separately registered and authorized.
stop_condition: Do not promote from ideal mean labels or low ensemble toy bias; do not tune signs, expand neighbours/positions or claim native conditional value. If actual pooled response lacks value or a pre-W1 rule fails the strongest same-count fixed control, stop that fixed instance.

three_direction_reformulation.identity: L(x_i)-meanL=A(x_i-mu); four centered rows have only3 independent token directions. Use3 Walsh/Haar contrast projections with the same frozenA, inverse and pooled response addition. The affine bias cancels.
three_direction_reformulation.substantive_change: Remove an exactly redundant affine mean direction and avoid wholeL/meanL/remainder intermediates, keeping the same response-point count. This is an algebraic execution representation change, not q/rank/seed expansion or originality of the Haar transform.
three_direction_reformulation.CPU_scope: 24 saved step2/block20 payloads; arbitrary four-row arithmetic fixtures, not spatial groups; labelled teacher mean is only an arithmetic test addend.
three_direction_reformulation.new_obstruction: Actual mixed-BF16 transform/GEMM/epilogue speed and model behaviour still need controls; the1.355x direct implementation failure remains true.
